page_title: ROM 3-1 ACM | AS Roma v AC Milan 18/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' Marco Piccinini is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+2' Referee Marco Piccinini has finally had enough of Sergio Conceicao and gives him a straight RED CARD!
90+1' Angelino (AS Roma) expertly wins the ball from the free kick, but his effort from the edge of the penalty area isn't accurate at all and the ball goes high over the crossbar.
90' 3 additional min. will be played.
90' What was Fikayo Tomori (AC Milan) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
90' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Filippo Terracciano (AC Milan) comes onto the pitch for Christian Pulisic.

87' 3 - 1 The ball rebounds and arrives at the feet of Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) just outside the box. He doesn't think twice and fires a brilliant shot into the bottom left corner. His attempt was beyond the reach of Mike Maignan. 3:1.

87' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) gets to a rebound in front of goal and sends the ball low towards the middle of the goal. However, he couldn't beat Mike Maignan, who shows off his superb goalkeeping ability by pulling off a great save.
84' Substitution. Matteo Gabbia is replaced by Riccardo Sottil (AC Milan).
84' Here is a change. Alexis Saelemaekers is going off and Claudio Ranieri gives the last tactical orders to Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma).
84' Substitution. Eldor Shomurodov leaves the pitch and is replaced by Tommaso Baldanzi (AS Roma).
84' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.

83' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball. The referee signals a corner kick to AC Milan.
79' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Mile Svilar.
78' Substitution. Leandro Paredes did his best and is replaced by Lucas Gourna-Douath (AS Roma).
78' Claudio Ranieri has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Devyne Rensch (AS Roma) replacing Matias Soule.
75' Zeki Celik (AS Roma) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
74' Angelino (AS Roma) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
73' A long through ball into the box almost gives Eldor Shomurodov (AS Roma) a good chance, but he loses out to one of the defenders.
72' The AS Roma players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
69' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
66' Sergio Conceicao decides to make a substitution. Joao Felix will be replaced by Rafael Leao (AC Milan).
65' Substitution. Luka Jovic (AC Milan) in, Ruben Loftus-Cheek out.
65' Substitution. Alejandro Jimenez will be replaced by Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan).
62' Alejandro Jimenez (AC Milan) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
61' Yellow card. Zeki Celik (AS Roma) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.

58' 2 - 1 Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) unleashes a beautiful rocket of a shot from a long-range free kick. The ball goes into the bottom left corner and leaves the goalkeeper beaten. This takes hours and hours on the training ground. The score is 2:1.
56' The resulting corner, taken by Christian Pulisic (AC Milan), comes to nothing.
55' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Christian Pulisic (AC Milan), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders. AC Milan will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

54' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Marco Piccinini blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. AC Milan have a free kick.
53' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
52' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 7:8.
51' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. He sends the ball into orbit. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AS Roma.
49' Half-chance! Alexis Saelemaekers (AS Roma) plays a pass into the box, but Mike Maignan reacts well to snuff out the attack.
49' Alejandro Jimenez (AC Milan) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AS Roma.
46' Angelino (AS Roma) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) makes a rough challenge and Marco Piccinini blows his whistle for a foul.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
45' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
42' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
42' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
39' 1 - 1 Goal! A rebound wrong foots everyone except Joao Felix (AC Milan), and he slams the ball into the open net from close range. 1:1.
39' Alejandro Jimenez (AC Milan) is put clear inside the box by a lofted pass. He only has the keeper to beat, but Mile Svilar comes out bravely to save at his feet. Great goalkeeping skills!
37' Joao Felix (AC Milan) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
36' Wonderful movement by AC Milan. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
34' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.
31' A cross into the box finds the head of Eldor Shomurodov (AS Roma) who steers it goalwards, but Mike Maignan manages to pull off a decent save to thwart him.
30' AS Roma are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
29' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
28' Matias Soule (AS Roma) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to AS Roma.
27' Alexis Saelemaekers (AS Roma) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.

27' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) receives a low pass just outside the box and drills a fine strike towards the middle of the goal. Mile Svilar pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
25' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.
25' Zeki Celik (AS Roma) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
21' Referee Marco Piccinini seems to have made up his mind after reviewing the incident using VAR, and it’s RED for Santiago Tomas Gimenez (AC Milan).

19' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Santiago Tomas Gimenez (AC Milan), but referee Marco Piccinini must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
18' Yunus Musah (AC Milan) produces a killer pass onto Santiago Tomas Gimenez, who loses the ball to one of the defenders.
17' Alejandro Jimenez (AC Milan) evades challenges and shoots from the edge of the box. It's a good effort, but flies just wide of the left post.
16' Alejandro Jimenez (AC Milan) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
13' Matias Soule (AS Roma) tries his luck from the edge of the box, but it's one to forget and goes well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and AC Milan will have a goal kick.
12' Joao Felix (AC Milan) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
9' Angelino (AS Roma) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
6' AS Roma are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears.

3' 1 - 0 Matias Soule takes over corner duties and expertly finds Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma), who jumps highest and coolly plants a bullet header into the right side of the goal. The score is now 1:0.
3' Matias Soule (AS Roma) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
3' Matias Soule (AS Roma) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball goes out of play. AS Roma are awarded a corner kick.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. AC Milan will have the kick-off.
Marco Piccinini is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups Both teams starting lineups are available now, so you can have a look at them.
